problems.problem: Contact detail crop (404,1099-1064,1349) confirms a genuine soft contact shadow under the left star tip at base_y 1239, so contact is NOT absent and offset_y 0 stays. But the footprint is only that 51px tip: the lower-right star point (approx x 830, y 1165 in the poster) hovers ~75px above the honed aluminium with zero occlusion, and the ground shows no reflected star image at all. On the concept's honed metal deck (brief cites R8's reflective floor, compare reference 5 where the Versace flacon casts a clear mirrored image) a translucent glass star with no reflection reads as a pasted cutout.

Light logic is still inverted against the hero: the brightest wall wash runs down the left third (x approx 60-420, y approx 0-900) exactly behind the Mugler/Angel ink column, while the zone behind the bottle (x approx 500-1000) is the darkest part of the wall. The executed cream title now floats on that bright wash with weak figure-ground separation, and the product silhouette loses its rim-light support. The horizon at y approx 905 also cuts straight through the translucent star body with no tint or bounce picked up from the metal ground.

The column still reads as a caption, not an instrument nameplate: title bbox 321x105px is only ~30% of canvas width beside a 500px-wide flacon, and the 168px steel-blue rule at y=700 sits ~19px under the title block then leaves ~520px of empty wall below it, so the stacked measure dissolves. References 1 and 3 keep column elements in a tight, confident measure; here the left half is starved next to the dense star silhouette.

Margins are unbalanced: bottle right edge x=984 leaves only 96px to the frame edge while the left column occupies x=76-397 with 484px of wall behind it, crowding the hero against the crop. Vertically, logo top (490) aligning with bottle top (490) is good, but nothing anchors the column base, so the two-column grid reads loose rather than deliberately zoned.

changes.value: Anodized aluminium wall in cool steel blue-grey with fine circular brush grain, meeting a continuous honed aluminium ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame; the wall keeps its brightest calm sheen in a broad vertical band right of centre and deepens gently toward the left third; the honed ground carries a faint soft mirrored vertical reflection and slight tonal deepening directly beneath the standing zone right of centre; cool diffuse twilight illumination, matte metal grain, no hard shadows, no objects
